name: Robotic Invasion 2
summary:
Robotic Invasion 2 is a dynamic 2D roguelite top-down shooter. A secret MindTech laboratory has revolted: floor after floor is overrun with combat robots, and only you can break through to the heart of the base.
Descend and evolve: 10 floors of the research complex, each more dangerous than the last. Regular rooms, elite bosses, special stations. Reach the bottom and fight the Final Boss of MindTech, and after victory, test your skills in the endless Survival mode.

Customize your build on the fly: Choose a class with a unique passive growth every level. Collect chips—stat boosts that can be upgraded by selecting them again. Find legendary items with special effects: experience magnets, overhealing, and more. Combine weapons, skills, and stats to suit your playstyle.
